source_caption:
📺 Liv and Maddie (2013–2017)

Liv and Maddie follows identical twin sisters Liv and Maddie Rooney, two teenagers with completely different personalities who reunite after Liv returns home from a successful acting career in Hollywood. While Liv loves the spotlight, fashion, and performing, Maddie is a talented basketball player who prefers sports and a more down-to-earth lifestyle. Despite their differences, the sisters share a strong bond as they navigate high school, friendships, relationships, and family challenges. Alongside their hilarious parents and mischievous younger brothers, the twins experience countless funny misunderstandings, heartfelt moments, and unexpected adventures. Combining family comedy, relatable teenage experiences, and emotional storytelling, the series explores sisterhood, individuality, friendship, and the importance of staying true to yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Teen Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 4 seasons • 80 episodes

🎥 Creators: John D. Beck and Ron Hart

🏆 Recognition: Starring Dove Cameron in both leading roles, the series became a popular Disney Channel comedy. Cameron won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performer in a Children’s, Preschool Children’s or Educational and Informational Program.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase, where available). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Liv and Maddie is an American teen sitcom created by John D. Beck and Ron Hart. It premiered on Disney Channel on July 19, 2013, and concluded after four seasons on March 24, 2017, with the episode "End-a-Rooney", which was also the series' eightieth episode. The series stars Dove Cameron, Joey Bragg, Tenzing Norgay Trainor, Kali Rocha, Benjamin King, and Lauren Lindsey Donzis. A significant feature of the series is that Dove Cameron plays dual roles, one being Liv, an actress who has returned to her home after starring on a popular television series in Hollywood for four years, and the other one being Maddie, Liv's identical twin who remained behind.
